outline: 本課程將教授質譜、紅外線光譜、核磁共振光譜及紫外線光譜等所提供的互補資料來鑑定有機化合物的結構。除了光譜的解釋之外，也會教授基本的分析原理。
schedule:
週次	授  課  內  容  要  項
1	1. General aspects of chromatography
2	2. Gas chromatography
3	3. High performance liquid chromatography
4	4. Ion chromatography
5	5. Planar chromatography
6	6. Supercritical fluid chromatography
7	7. Sizeclusion
8	8. Capillaty electrophoresis
9	9. Nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy
10	10. Infrared spectroscopy
11	11. Ultraviolet and Visible absorption spectroscopy
12	12. Fluorimetry
13	13. X-ray fluorescences spectrometry
14	14. Atomic absorption and flame emission spectroscopy
15	15. Atomic emission spectroscopy
16	16. Mass spectrometry
17	17. Potentiometric methods
18	18. Coulometric and voltammetric methods
assessment:
各次考試同樣重要
總積分除以考試次數為學期成績
